title: Homeomorphism type of exponential Knaster continua
exact_target: Do the explicitly defined invariant strip sets have the same topology for all real exponential parameters greater than $1/e$?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300063 (AMR-052-0063). CC BY 4.0.

Robert Devaney, ``Open Questions in Non-Rational Complex Dynamics'', in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (eds.), Problems in Holomorphic Dynamics (1992), third problem in Section 3 (Knaster-like continua), pp. 36; arXiv:math/9205209v1.
